alltime.source: Career lines for 442 players from ESPN career statistics (full WNBA history: 442 career lines, 0 collected-window fallbacks), not just the 2010→2026 box scores; as of 2026-10-03T16:20:04Z

goat.formula: GOAT score = 35% career production (PTS 35%, REB 15%, AST 15%, STL 10%, BLK 10%, 3PM 5%, +/- 10% of the component; each stat is a 50%/50% blend of career total and per-game rate vs the best career among qualified players, and a stat the career never had (impossible-zero totals, a stat the career never attempted, no collected-box-score game for +/-) is dropped from his blend with the rest rescaled; +/- comes only from this repo's collected box scores because ESPN's career statistics carry none, so it starts with the 2010 window and a negative career +/- scores zero instead of negative credit) + 30% official WNBA honours (points per win: MVP ×6, Finals MVP ×5, DPOY ×4.5, All-WNBA 1st ×3, All-Def 1st ×2.5, All-WNBA 2nd ×2, All-Def 2nd ×1.5, ROY ×1.5, 6MOY ×1.5, MIP ×1.5, All-Star MVP ×1.5, Cup MVP ×1, All-Rookie ×0.5, Sportsmanship ×0.25, Comm. Assist ×0.25) + 25% peak (best season's per-game impact) + 10% championships (title count vs the most among qualified players: champion-season rows (Finals-MVP team refs cover every season since 1997)), each component 0-100 vs the best qualified player; a component with no data for a player (impossible-zero career total, untrusted peak, unknown title count, no honours input) is dropped for him and the remaining weights rescaled; requires ≥82 career games.
goat.source: Production: career totals vs the best career among qualified players (+/- summed from collected box scores only, 2010 onward); honours: 810 official WNBA award wins across 15 award types (343 award seasons read); peak: best season impact from trusted ESPN season rows or the collected window; championship counts (29 champion seasons indexed); as of 2026-10-03T16:20:04Z

career_note: All-WNBA-history careers for 442 players (career leaders + official-award winners + 402 collected players ≥41 GP), 810 official honours across 15 award types; as of 2026-10-03T16:20:04Z. ESPN quirks kept as-is: careers whose season rows can't be trusted show blank peak/seasons.
